concerns.text: The acceptance scenario states "Given the dataset contains >100 hypothesis tests (5 traits × N genres)" but then applies a Bonferroni correction using α = 0.05/50 ≈ 0.001, which corresponds to exactly 50 tests (5 traits × 10 genres). This creates a logical inconsistency between the claimed number of tests (>100) and the correction denominator (50).
